      "observations": [
        "Retained complete21-path source study reused. Fresh original code/test-adapter hunks and needed fixed JS/Rust/IDL consumers reconcile all34 actual submitted review rows and full primary timeline. No full repeated source/test pass claimed.",
        "Typed nsIMsgOutgoingListener separates start’s cancelable request from terminal server URI/status/security/localized text. Reviewer proposes a request argument at finish/onFinishRequest naming; author rejects the unused finish argument and actual landing keeps onSendStart/onSendStop. Callback docs are rewritten around when called and purpose, with local JSDoc types and declared #private fields.",
        "The author explicitly defends original production requestPromise resolution on start so _deliverAsMail can retrieve cancellation state; the unit adapter instead waits for onSendStop. Fixed production code now retains request on start and normally settles after awaited sendDeliveryCallback on stop, except the documented nsMsgSendUnsent limitation. Stale current start-resolved comments do not override executed code.",
        "The original NewsDeliveryListener call and forwarding branch have argument-order/omitted-serverURI hazards against the then-new signature. Current callbacks use serverURI,exitCode,secInfo,errMsg,isNewsDelivery and the news caller passes null payloads plus true correctly. This is a source comparison, not a reproduced NNTP failure.",
        "The existing dedicated sendLogger, generic nsIURI.asciiHostPort, temporary Promise.withResolvers bindings, useful parameter descriptions and enforced field privacy are applied. The proposed declaration binding directly into this fields is not the landed syntax. Rust flattened match shape and TransportSecurityFailure/TransportSecurityInfo names clarify transport negotiation; fully qualified Debug is a local suggestion, while fixed error.rs later imports Debug.",
        "Current moz_http keeps the original nsresult with security context and converts back to that status. Unlike the historical strict getter_addrefs path, fixed GetSecurityInfo null out parameter Err(NS_OK) becomes None and preserves the ordinary request error. Service lookup/real accessor failures still propagate. Author verified an old accessor contract then replaced the inference with IsNSSErrorCode(GetErrorCode); paired Gecko implementation was not independently audited here.",
        "The opaque Debug implementation explains that the wrapped XPCOM value lacks Debug. The error display still contains doubled braces {{status}}; it is not established useful numeric output or a privacy policy. Current safe wrapper clones/forgets a RefPtr into an IDL input; existing ownership gap remains unresolved without generated binding/callee lifetime proof, not a confirmed leak.",
        "Current EWS CreateItem uses SendOnly because MessageSend owns sent-folder copying/Bcc headers and forwards transport failures silently to the listener path. Current SMTP guards one terminal notification and cancellation, awaits listener cleanup, and resolves its own completion promise even on protocol failure; the listener handles success/failure separately.",
        "Fresh test_sendMailMessage directly checks SMTP transaction sequence after a terminal adapter promise, not message bytes or EWS certificate UI. Other changed tests remain covered by the retained complete study. Full Bug1922821 comments0–3 and D224800 full timeline/all34 actual rows read, including local TLS test instructions. Those instructions require setup/source changes and were not executed. Try Windows bustage attribution, screenshots, parent/obsolete reviews and later regression links remain uninspected historical context."
      ],

        "Current moz_http keeps the original nsresult with security context and converts back to that status. Unlike the historical strict getter_addrefs path, fixed GetSecurityInfo null out parameter Err(NS_OK) becomes None and preserves the ordinary request error. Service lookup/real accessor failures still propagate.         "The opaque Debug implementation explains that the wrapped XPCOM value lacks Debug.
